annotations.title: FX Rates (ECB reference rates via Frankfurter)

description: [PAID — 0.004 USDC on Base via x402] Foreign-exchange reference rates for any base and up to 40 quote currencies, latest or historical back to 1999, from the European Central Bank's euro reference rates via Frankfurter. End-of-day reference rates, not tradeable quotes; unsupported currencies are listed, never guessed. Cached 30 minutes. $0.004 USDC on Base, paid via x402 by the calling agent's own wallet. Call with no payment_header first to receive the payment requirements; your own wallet pays, never this server's.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD (1999-01-04 or later); omit for latest.

payment_header.description: Optional. Omit on your first call to receive the x402 payment challenge for free. After your own wallet/x402 client signs against that challenge, call this same tool again with the SAME business arguments plus this field set to the header your x402 client produced (typically { name: "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE", value: "<base64 payload>" }). This server never holds a wallet and never pays on your behalf.

name.description: HTTP header name to attach, e.g. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

value.description: HTTP header value (the signed payment payload).

quotes.description: Quote currency codes; default EUR GBP JPY CHF CAD AUD CNY MXN INR BRL.
